daily_senate_floor_activity.title: Today's Senate Floor Activity
daily_senate_floor_activity.intro_text: The President pro tempore called the Senate to order at 12 noon, the Chaplain offered a prayer, and the President pro tempore led the Senate in reciting the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag of the United States of America.

section.content: Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the Journal of the proceedings of the Senate was deemed approved to date.
Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the morning hour being deemed expired, and the times for the recognition of the two leaders being reserved.
The following transactions of morning business occurred on today .

document.document_title: A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exclude from gross income any damages, other than punitive damages, received on account of any sexual acts or sexual contact .
document.document_status_text: Cloture motion on the measure presented in Senate.

document.document_title: In the nature of a substitute.
document.amendment_status_text: Cloture motion on amendment SA 6883 presented in Senate.

document.document_title: A bill to increase, effective as of December 1, 2026, the rates of compensation for veterans with service-connected disabilities and the rates of dependency and indemnity compensation for the survivors of certain disabled veterans, and for other purposes .
document.document_status_text: Passed Senate without amendment by Voice Vote.

document.document_title: Daniel Lewis Ballou, of Kentucky, to be United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Kentucky
document.document_status_text: Motion to proceed to executive session to consideration of nomination agreed to in Senate by Voice Vote.

section.content: By unanimous consent, on the request of Ms. Collins, at 4:05 p.m., the Senate adjourned, under its order of today, until 12 noon tomorrow.
